findings.claim: The commit changes addons/intelligence/app/main.py to raise the `pdfminer` logger to ERROR. That backend logging change is not in the spec's touch-point list and has nothing to do with transcript touch actions.
findings.impact: In the intelligence service, every pdfminer WARNING is now silent, for all PDFs and not only the per-glyph FontBBox noise the comment names. A PDF whose text pdfminer extracts poorly but only warns about will no longer leave any trace in the logs. The change also ships under a transcript-UI spec, with no spec or test of its own.
findings.evidence: addons/intelligence/app/main.py:61-63 adds `logging.getLogger("pdfminer").setLevel(logging.ERROR)`. The touch points in docs/specs/transcript-touch-actions.md name no backend file, and invariants.md has no Revisions. pdfminer is used by addons/intelligence/app/extractors/pdf.py.

bucket_proposal.reason: It breaks no declared invariant. It is an unplanned place outside the declared touch points, and it changes a log level for the whole service.

findings.proposed_fix: Move the pdfminer log-level change into its own change (or the PDF spec that owns pdfminer), or add it to this spec's touch points.
